title: Gobhi ka Salan (Cauliflower Curry)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A rich, spicy vegetarian curry that goes with nearly anything.

steps.action: Heat in a large pot over high, 2 min:

items: 1 tsp yellow or brown mustard seeds

steps.action: Add and fry, stirring often, up to 10 min, until lightly browned:
Mix in; cover and simmer on medium-low (3/10) 15 min:
items: 3 medium tomatoes, chopped (or 14 oz / 400 g can)

steps.action: Mix in a couple of Tbsp at a time; cover and simmer 10 min:

items: 1 cup loosely packed cilantro, chopped (reserve a little for garnish)

steps.action: Add, mix, and bring to a boil on high:
items: 1½ lb cauliflower florets (700 g), plum-sized; from a 2.2 lb (1 kg) head

steps.action: Cover; simmer on medium-low 10 min. Taste a piece; if not done, repeat.
Cover, turn off heat, and rest 5 min. Adjust salt.

items: 3 green chilies, halved lengthwise (or 1 jalapeño, in rings)
